name: Incline dumbbell press
notes: Incline dumbbell press, bench set around 30 degrees. Record the load of one dumbbell.

guide.setup: Lie back on a bench inclined around 30 degrees with a dumbbell in each hand, feet planted, and shoulder blades pulled together.
guide.execution: Lower the dumbbells to either side of the upper chest, then press them up until the arms are straight.
guide.cues: Keep the upper back anchored. Keep wrists over elbows. Press evenly.
guide.mistakes: Setting the bench too steep; flaring elbows straight out; bouncing at the bottom; lifting the hips off the bench.
